_comment: Layer definitions for build_pack.py. bbox = [south, west, north, east] in degrees. A layer is either bbox-based or centred on an airfield (ICAO) with half_km. Spacing is in arc-seconds (aligned to the Copernicus grid) or metres (upsampled). quant_m = height quantisation step; blend_m = distance over which the layer fades into the next coarser one at its edges.

runways._comment: Runways flattened into every layer that covers them. Geometry from OurAirports (public domain).
